HubExportArea.description: Which folder of the hub's home a carried file belongs to: `recordings` is `browser/`, the others their own name.

HubExportBytes.description: A BLOB in a row of a hub's export.

HubExportFile.description: A file of the hub's home in a hub's export.

modifiedAt.description: When the file last changed, which is when a memory or a skill says it was last written. Absent: when it is imported.

name.description: Its path inside its area's folder, with `/` between its parts.

sha256.description: Of the file's bytes, in hex.

HubExportFiles.description: One area's files in a hub's export.

HubExportHeader.description: The first entry of a hub's export (`fleetd-export.json`): what a reader needs before the rest. The file is one uncompressed tar, read front to back: this header, each table's rows (`tables/<table>/<n>.jsonl.gz`, one HubExportRow a line), the hub's files (`files/<n>`), then HubExportManifest (`manifest.json`) and the manifest's SHA-256 in hex (`manifest.sha256`).

createdAt.description: When the export's snapshot of the hub was taken.

fleetd.description: The fleetd version that wrote it.

secrets.description: The key its secrets are sealed under, wrapped under the passphrase. Absent: it carries no secrets.

version.description: The format's version, 1 today. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows and says to update fleetd.

HubExportKdf.description: How an export's passphrase becomes a key: scrypt.

HubExportMachine.description: A machine the exported hub had. Machines aren't carried: each joins the new hub again under its id.

HubExportManifest.description: What a hub's export holds (`manifest.json`, after everything it names): every part with its size and checksum. A reader checks them all, and the manifest against `manifest.sha256`, before it changes anything.

files.description: The carried files of the hub's home, by area.

fleetd.description: The fleetd version that wrote it.

schema.description: The hub migrations the rows are at, in the order fleetd runs them. A reader that lacks one refuses the file and says to update fleetd; it runs the ones it has after them.

secretsLeftOut.description: True when the export was written without secrets: the tables that hold them aren't in it.

tables.description: One per carried table, a table with no rows too.

HubExportMigration.description: A hub migration, as `migrations_applied` records it.

sha256.description: Of the migration's SQL, in hex.

HubExportPart.description: An entry of a hub's export under the manifest's checksum.

sha256.description: Of the entry's bytes, in hex.

HubExportRow.description: A row of a carried table: each column by its name.

HubExportSealed.description: A secret in a row of a hub's export, in place of a value the hub held sealed to its own key: sealed under the export's key (HubExportSecrets), never in the clear.

HubExportSecrets.description: The export's own key, as the header keeps it.

wrapped.description: The 32-byte key under AES-256-GCM with the passphrase's key: nonce, ciphertext and tag, base64.

HubExportTable.description: One table's rows in a hub's export.

columns.description: The table's columns, as each row names them.

sequence.description: The table's AUTOINCREMENT counter, so the numbers the new hub gives go on after it.

HubExportTablePart.description: One part of a table's rows: gzip of one JSON object a line.

sha256.description: Of the part's bytes as stored, in hex.

HubExportValue.description: A database value in a row of a hub's export: NULL, INTEGER or REAL, TEXT, a BLOB, or a secret.
